παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’) · also with αὐτόφι: παρ’ αὐτόφι ’right beside’ (the suffix -φι marks place) · also in παρ’ αὐτόθι, adverbial: ’right there, on the spot’
παραίφασίς: παραίφασις — persuasion, encouragement, comforting talk; fem. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐστιν
παρειπών: παρεῖπον (aor. of παραφημί) — talk over, win over with words; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having persuaded’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; + dat./acc./gen. · also adv., ’beside (him)’ (παρὰ δὲ … Ἥρη ’and beside him Hera’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρὰ … βάλλετ’ = παραβάλλετε ’set beside’)
πεπλήγετο: πλήσσω — strike; mid. strike one’s own (body); epic reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’struck (his thighs)’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’)
πεσόντα: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having fallen’
πεσών: πίπτω — fall; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having fallen’
πλεῖσται: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl. superlative πλεῖστος, agreeing with φάλαγγες: ’the most numerous’
πολεμίζειν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf.: πόλεμον πολεμίζειν ’to wage war’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολύστονος: πολύστονος — much-groaning, full of sorrow (πολύς + στόνος ’groan’); masc./fem. nom. sg. (two-termination adj.)
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
ποτε: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv. · with a negative or ἤν: ’never, if ever’
πουλυδάμαντος: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, a Trojan, Hector’s counsellor; masc. gen. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Πολυδάμαντος)
πουλυδάμας: Πουλυδάμας — Polydamas, Trojan counsellor; masc. nom. sg., epic πουλυ- (= Attic Πολυδάμας)
ποῦ: ποῦ — where?; interrog. adv., in a direct question
προμάχοισιν: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), after ἐμίχθη: ’among the front-fighters’
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; prep. + gen., also adv.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
πρύμνῃσι: πρύμνη — stern, hind part of a ship; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πτόλεμός: πτόλεμος — war (epic by-form of πόλεμος); masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
πυκινὸν: πυκινός — thick, close-set, solid; masc. acc. sg.: ’solid’ · also masc. acc. sg., of a plot: ’close-woven, cunning’ (πυκινὸν δόλον ’a cunning trap’) · also neut. acc. sg., of a word: ’shrewd’ (πυκινὸν ἔπος ’a shrewd word’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with νέφος: ’dense’ (πυκινὸν νέφος ’dense cloud’) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with λέχος: ’solid’ (πυκινὸν λέχος ’a solid bed’)
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
στόμα: στόμα — mouth, face; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’mouth’ (κεφαλὴ στόμα τε ῥῖνές τε ’head and mouth and nostrils’)
στῆθος: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’breast’ (Ἥρῃ … στῆθος ’Hera’s breast’)
σφ: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. pron., elided σφ’ for dat. σφι ’for them, their’ or acc. σφε ’them’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)
σὲ: σύ — you (sg.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἀνῆκεν: ’you’ · also acc. sg., of the person in need, with χρεώ: ’(need of) you’ · also acc. sg., object of ἐπιδωσόμεθ’: ’you’
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (σὺν … ταράξῃ = συνταράξῃ ’throw into confusion’)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν · also accented before the enclitic οἱ (ἀτάρ τέ οἱ ὄζοι ’but its branches’, τε being the epic particle of what is always so, not translated) · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it, accented before an enclitic: ἦ τέ σ’ ὀΐω ’I truly suspect you’ · also accented before the enclitic σφισιν (ἀπό τέ σφισιν ’and from them’) · also accented before the enclitic ποτ’ (ὅς τέ ποτ’), the epic particle of what holds generally, not translated
τέκτονος: τέκτων — builder, carpenter, craftsman; masc. gen. sg.
τέτατο: τείνω — stretch, extend; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’was stretched out’
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’) · also indefinite τίς with a negative: ’no one’ (οὐ γάρ τίς … ἀνήρ ’for no man’) · also indefinite τις after μή, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’lest someone’ (μή τίς τοι … πήξῃ ’lest someone fix … in you’) · also indefinite τίς with a noun in a question after ἦ: ’some’ (ἦ τίς … θεός ’or some god’) · also indefinite τίς after μή, before the enclitic οἱ: ’lest anyone’ (μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ’lest anyone go off’) · also indefinite τίς after εἴ ποτε, written τίς before the enclitic τοι: ’if ever anyone’ (εἴ ποτέ τίς τοι)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τείχεος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted -εος (= Attic τείχους)
τελαμώνιον: Τελαμώνιος — son of Telamon, Telamonian; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τεῖχος: τεῖχος — wall; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’wall’
τεῦκρε: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, half-brother of Ajax; masc. voc. sg.
τεῦκρον: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, a Greek warrior; masc. acc. sg.
τεῦκρος: Τεῦκρος — Teucer, Greek hero at Troy, half-brother of Ajax; masc. nom. sg.
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοκεῦσιν: τοκεύς — parent (usually pl. ’parents’); masc. dat. pl., ν-movable
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board) · also neut. gen. sg. demonstrative, ’of this, that’, as the object of a verb taking the genitive (τοῦ δ’ ἐπιλήσονται ’but that they will forget’) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ, temporal: ’from that time’ · also masc. gen. sg., ’the other’, after πρό (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it, its’ (τοῦ δέκα οἶμοι ’ten bands of it’) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of comparison: ’than he, than him’ (after ἀμείνων)
τρωσί: Τρώς — a Trojan; masc. dat. pl. (Τρῶες, Τρωσί): ’Trojans’
τρώεσσι: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρῶές: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl., accented before the enclitic τε
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (βῶν ἀζαλέην, τό μοι ἔστι … ’the dry hide, which is mine to …’)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τόξῳ: τόξον — bow; neut. dat. sg., after πέλασεν: ’to the bow’ · also dat. of means: ’with the bow’ (τόξῳ ἐπιπλήσσων ’striking with the bow’) · also neut. dat. sg. of place after ἐν: ’in the bow’
τόφρ: τόφρα — so long, during that time; adv., correlative with ὄφρα ’as long as’, elided (τόφρ’ = τόφρα)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’ · also dual nom. with a noun, article-like: ’the two’ (τὼ … ὄσσε ’his two eyes’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup)
τῷδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; demonstrative pron., masc. dat. sg., standing alone: ’this man’ · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ἤματι: ’this’ (ἤματι τῷδε ’on this day’)
υἱέϊ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic υἱέϊ (= Attic υἱεῖ)
υἷα: υἱός — son; acc. sg., epic υἷα (= Attic υἱόν)
φάθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (φάθ’ = φάτο before rough breathing): ’so she spoke’
φάλαγγας: φάλαγξ — line of battle, battle-line, phalanx; fem. acc. pl.
φάλαγγες: φάλαγξ — battle-line, line of battle; fem. nom. pl.
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’were carrying’
φίλοισι: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin or body parts serves as a possessive); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
φαίδιμος: φαίδιμος — shining, glorious, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Hector · also epithet of Ajax (φαίδιμος Αἴας) · also epithet of Glaucus (φαίδιμος υἱός ’glorious son’)
φαεινῷ: φαεινός — shining, bright, radiant; masc./neut. dat. sg.
φαρέτρην: φαρέτρη — quiver; fem. acc. sg., epic -ην (Ionic η for α; Attic φαρέτρᾱν)
φοῖβος: Φοῖβος — Phoebus, epithet of Apollo (‘bright, radiant’); masc. nom. sg.
φόβος: Φόβος — Terror, Rout personified (cf. φόβος ’flight, fear’); masc. nom. sg. · also φόβος — flight, fear (not personified); masc. nom. sg.: ’terror’ (φόβος ἔλλαβε πάντας ’terror seized all’)
χάρμης: χάρμη — joy of battle, eagerness to fight; fem. gen. sg.
χαλκοκορυστῇ: χαλκοκορυστής — armed in bronze; masc. dat. sg., epithet
χαμάδις: χαμάδις — to the ground, groundward; adv.
χαριζόμενος: χαρίζομαι — gratify, please (+ dat.); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’gratifying, pleasing’
χερσὶ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -σί (= Attic χερσίν)
ἀΰσας: ἀΰω — shout, call aloud; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’calling out’
ἀγαθὴ: ἀγαθός — good; adj., fem. nom. sg., predicate, agreeing with παραίφασις
ἀγαυοῦ: ἀγαυός — noble, illustrious; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Τυδέος · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Λαομέδοντος: ’noble (Laomedon)’ · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Πηλεΐωνος: ’noble (son of Peleus)’ · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Τιθωνοῖο: ’noble (Tithonus)’ · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ἰδομενῆος: ’noble (Idomeneus)’ · also masc. gen. sg., agreeing with Ἰλιονῆος: ’noble (Ilioneus)’
ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, bright, radiant; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’splendid (son)’
ἀγχιμαχηταὶ: ἀγχιμαχητής — close-fighter, one who fights hand to hand; masc. voc. pl. (identical with nom.), in address
ἀθήνης: Ἀθήνη — Athena; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Ἀθηνᾶς)
ἀκόντισε: ἀκοντίζω — hurl a javelin, throw a spear; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠκόντισε): ’hurled’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφ: ἀμφί — around, about; prep. + acc., elided (ἀμφ’) · also prep. + dat., ’about, on’ (ἀμφ’ ὀβελοῖσιν ’on spits’) · also adv. and preverb in tmesis, elided: ’round about’ (ἀμφ’ … ἀΰτευν ’rang round about’)
ἀμφεμάχοντο: ἀμφιμάχομαι — fight around; impf. 3 pl. mid./dep., + acc.: ’fought around’
ἀμύμονι: ἀμύμων — blameless (the real sense is not known); masc./fem. dat. sg. (two-ending adj.)
ἀνεψιὸν: ἀνεψιός — cousin; masc. acc. sg., in apposition to a name: ’cousin’
ἀπέκτανε: ἀποκτείνω — kill; aor. 3 sg. act., epic 2nd aor. ἀπέκτανε (= Attic ἀπέκτεινε): ’killed’
ἀπηύρα: ἀπαυράω — take away, rob, deprive of; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with the ending -α: ’took away’
ἀπώσασθαι: ἀπωθέω — push away, thrust off; aor. inf. mid.: ’to thrust off’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀργείοισι: Ἀργεῖοι — Argives, Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀριστεύοντα: ἀριστεύω — be the best, excel in fight; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’excelling’
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀφ: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἀφ’ = ἀπό)
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλῆα: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., epic Ἀχιλῆα (= Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
ἄγχι: ἄγχι — near, close; adv.: ’close by’ · also prep. + gen.: ’near’
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg. · also ἄλλον … ἄλλον, correlative: ’one … another’
ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’
ἄλλῃσι: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ἄλλαις), agreeing with πύλῃσιν
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’) · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb: ’off’ (ἄπο … νίζοντες ’washing off’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἅμαρθ: ἁμαρτάνω — miss (+ gen. of the mark); aor. 3 sg., elided and aspirated (ἅμαρθ’ = ἥμαρτε): ’missed’
ἐδύναντο: δύναμαι — be able, can; impf. 3 pl. mid.: ’they could’
ἐκέκλετο: κέλομαι — command, call to; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, + dat.: ’called to, bade’
ἐμίχθη: μίγνυμι — mix, mingle (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg. pass.: ’was mingled’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐναντίος: ἐναντίος — opposite, face to face; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’facing’
ἐνθάδε: ἐνθάδε — hither, to this place; adv. of motion · also ’here, in this place’ (ἐνθάδε μιμνόντεσσι ’for those who stay here’)
ἐνιπρῆσαι: ἐμπίμπρημι — set on fire, burn; aor. inf. act., epic ἐνιπρῆσαι (= Attic ἐμπρῆσαι): ’to burn’
ἐνόησε: νοέω — perceive, notice, think; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’noticed’
ἐνόησεν: νοέω — perceive, notice, think of; aor. 3 sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’) · also in ἐξ αὖτις, adverbial: ’again, once more’
ἐξείλετο: ἐξαιρέω — take out; mid. take out for oneself, pick out; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’took out for himself’
ἐξελάσαι: ἐξελαύνω — drive out; aor. inf. act., + gen. of separation: ’to drive out (of)’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’) · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (left) side’ (ἐπ’ ἀριστερόφιν ’on the left’) · also + gen., ’on’ (ἐπ’ εὐνάων ’on anchor-stones’)
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπεσσυμένους: ἐπισεύω — drive on; perf. part. mid./pass. masc. acc. pl., ἐπέσσυμαι intrans.: ’rushing on’
ἐπύθοντο: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear, find out; aor. 3 pl. mid. dep., augmented: ’learned’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρύκακεν: ἐρύκω — hold back, restrain; aor. 3 sg. act., epic reduplicated ἐρύκακε(ν) (= Attic ἔρυξε), ν-movable; with κέν: ’could have held back’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐτίομεν: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 1 pl. act.: ’we were honouring’
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἱπποπόλων Θρῃκῶν ’toward the horse-herding Thracians’)
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐόντας: εἰμί — be; pres. part. acc. pl. masc., epic (= Attic ὄντας)
ἑσταότ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότα, Attic ἑστηκότα): ’standing’ · also neut. acc. pl., elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότα), agreeing with δούρατα: ’standing’
ἑταίρου: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. gen. sg., of cause with ἀχνύμενος: ’for the comrade’ · also masc. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of a companion’ (παραίφασις ἑταίρου ’a companion’s persuasion’) · also masc. gen. sg. after παρά: ’from a companion’ (παρ’ ἑταίρου) · also masc. gen. sg., object of ἀμέλησεν: ’neglect his companion’
ἑταῖρον: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. sg.
ἑταῖρος: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. sg.
ἔβαινον: βαίνω — go, step; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they went’ (ἐν … ἔβαινον ’they went aboard’)
ἔβαλε: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’struck, hit’ · also ’put, laid’ in tmesis (ἐν … ἔβαλε ’laid on’)
ἔβαλεν: βάλλω — throw, hurl, strike; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’threw’ (κὰδ … ἔβαλεν = κατέβαλεν ’laid low’)
ἔγχεσιν: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. pl.: ’with spears’ (instrumental)
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔκβαλε: ἐκβάλλω — cast out, throw out, hurl from; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέβαλε)
ἔκειτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up, be stored; impf. 3 sg.
ἔκπεσε: ἐκπίπτω — fall out, fall from; aor. 3 sg.: of a tear, ’fell from’ (+ dat. of the person) · also ’fell out of’ + gen., of a broken blade (ἔκπεσε χειρός ’fell from the hand’) · also aor. 3 sg., of a man falling from a vehicle, + gen.: ’fell out of’ (ἔκπεσε δίφρου ’fell out of the chariot’)
ἔκτυπε: κτυπέω — crash, resound, thunder; aor. 3 sg., strong aorist: ’thundered’
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’steady’
ἔμπης: ἔμπης — nevertheless, in any case, for all that; adv.
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv.
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔπαυσε: παύω — stop, make cease (+ gen. of what is ended); aor. 3 sg. act.: ’stopped’
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχ: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’held, kept’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔχ’ = ἔχε): ’keep, hold’
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’) · also pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter subject: ’holding’
ἔχοντα: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg.: ’having, holding’ · also with ἄλγεα: ’suffering, enduring’ · also of clothing: ’wearing’
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address · also masc. acc. sg., epic elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορα), object of σχήσουσι: ’Hector’ (πελώριον Ἕκτορ’ ’huge Hector’) · also masc. dat. sg., elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορι), after ἅμα: ’with Hector’ (ἅμ’ Ἕκτορ’ ἴσαν ’went with Hector’)
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλκεϊ: ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἕλκει)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form) · also demonstrative, ’she’ (ἣ δ’ … βεβήκει) · also demonstrative in the correlative ἣ μὲν … ἣ δέ: ’one … another’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἣ πληθύς ’the throng’)
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤλυθεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; epic aor. 3 sg. (= Attic ἦλθεν): ’came, passed’
ἤριπε: ἐρείπω — throw down; in the intransitive aor. ἤριπον, fall headlong, crash down; aor. 3 sg.: ’fell headlong’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἰαχή: ἰαχή — cry, shout, war-cry; fem. nom. sg.
ἰὸς: ἰός — arrow; masc. nom. sg. (not ἰός ’poison’)
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱεμένων: ἵεμαι — hasten, press on, be eager; pres. part. mid. masc. gen. pl.: ’hastening’
ἲς: ἴς — force, strength, might; fem. nom. sg.
ἴσχειν: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, keep; pres. inf. act., as an imperative: ’(you must) hold’ · also pres. inf. act., complementary after δύναται: ’to hold back’
ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
ἶσα: ἴσος — equal; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’equally’
ὀδυνάων: ὀδύνη — pain, ache, anguish; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
ὀλοφυρόμενος: ὀλοφύρομαι — lament, wail; pres. part. mid. dep. masc. nom. sg.: ’lamenting’
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)
ὀτρύνω: ὀτρύνω — urge on, stir; pres. 1 sg. act. indic. or subj.: ’I urge on’
ὀφέλλει: ὀφέλλω — increase, strengthen, add to; pres. 3 sg. (distinct from ὀφείλω ’owe’)
ὀφθαλμοῖσιν: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν)
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὀϊστούς: ὀϊστός — arrow; masc. acc. pl. (= Attic ὀιστούς)
ὀϊστὸν: ὀϊστός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ὀιστόν)
ὁππότ: ὁππότε (elided ὁππότ’) — whenever, when; epic (= Attic ὁπότε)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
ὄρωρεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; perf. 3 sg. with ν-movable: ’has arisen’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ ἵππω πλήξαντε … βάλον ’until the two horses struck … and threw’) · also temporal, ’while’ + subj. in a general clause (ὄφρ’ εὕδῃσι ’while … sleeps’) · also temporal ’until, while’ + ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ ἀπόλοιτο ’so that he might perish’) · also temporal, ’while’ with ἄν + subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἐγὼ … δύω ’while I put on’)
ὄχεα: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. acc. pl., after ἐς: ’into the chariot’ · also neut. acc. pl., object of κροτάλιζον: ’the chariots’ (κείν’ ὄχεα κροτάλιζον ’rattled empty chariots’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑπερώησαν: ὑπερωέω — swerve aside, shy (sense uncertain); aor. 3 pl. act., epic, unaugmented
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’)
ὕπτιος: ὕπτιος — on one’s back, face up; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own; masc. acc. dual, taken so with μηρώ: ’his own (two thighs)’ (dual form, not the relative)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤσασθαι: ὠθέω — push, thrust; aor. inf. mid.: ’to thrust back’
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., with ἔπι: ’on account of which’ (ᾗ ἔπι ’for which’)
ᾤμωξέν: οἰμώζω — wail, cry out in distress; aor. 3 sg., augmented ᾤ- (οἰ- → ᾠ-), movable ν: ’wailed’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥηξάμενοι: ῥήγνυμι — break, break through; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having broken’
ῥῆξ: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst through; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, elided ῥῆξ’ = ῥῆξε (= Attic ἔρρηξε)
